designDecisionsAndRationale: architecture.md 'Final gate and archival rule (session 467)' item 2: s467 is docs and plans only, because every PF-27 source deliverable already exists at f6f4ba8
Item 3: the gate reuses the s466 16 must-pass lines with -s467- log names, keeping evidence uncached and comparable
Item 4: the s466 manifest no longer drives dispatch, so it is archived after s460..s465; the s467 manifest stays in active/ as the final manifest
Item 6: only impl-plans/README.md is relinked; historical active/ path mentions stay as session records
Item 7: closing notes are insert-only, preserving the CF history table
intentionalTradeoffs: Single serial plan with no sharedPaths: archival and index edits are global serialization points
Each archived file is declared as an active/completed file pair (86 entries) rather than directory entries, for exact write ownership
pf-27-finalize.md is 476 lines (over the 400-line guideline, under the 1000-line limit)
Gate line 24 (no foreign edits, including architecture.md) relies on this docs checkpoint commit landing before implementation
supportedEdgeCases: Any gate failure: stop, route to the owner, restart from line 1 as attempt n+1, no archival
go test -race flakiness in lines 7 or 11 forces a fresh attempt from line 1
grep -c '(cached)' exiting 1 is the required result for lines 8 and 11
Later '**Status**:' lines inside progress logs (pf-14b, pf-18, pf-24) stay untouched; only line 3 changes
Superseded indexes use 'Completed (superseded by ...)' wording, which still matches line 20
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Repairing source defects inside PF-27 (they are reconciliation requests to the owning accepted plan)
Hand-editing go.mod/go.sum to make tidy clean
